meta.what: Per company cost coefficients for the comparison tab, so a slider can reprice the S&P 500 in the browser.
meta.caveat: Every coefficient here measures an exposure the company already carries. This file prices that exposure at a rate you choose. It forecasts nothing, and no slider position is a claim about any future price.
meta.join_key: companies are keyed by ticker and join to the company rows of snapshot.json on that ticker.
meta.cost_formula: cost_musd = carbon_mt * carbon_price + water_mt * water_surcharge + conduct * conduct_multiple + shortfall * credibility_charge
meta.how_to_use_coverage: companies[ticker].cov is one flag per driver in the order [carbon_price, water_surcharge, conduct_multiple, credibility_charge]. A flag of 0 means we have no number and the coefficient is null. Grey the driver for that company. Do not read a null as a zero.

units.name: company name
units.sec: index into meta.sectors, the GICS sector
units.rev: revenue, US$ millions, latest fiscal year
units.ebit: operating income, US$ millions, latest fiscal year
units.evic: enterprise value including cash, US$ millions, market cap plus book total debt
units.w_idx: weight in our cap weighted S&P 500, percent, 503 companies, sums to 100
units.w_cap: weight in the cap weighted index of paris.json, percent, 499 companies
units.w_par: weight in the Paris aligned index of paris.json, percent, 499 companies
units.in_par: true if the company survives the exclusion rules of EU 2020/1818
units.barred: the article that excluded it, null if held
units.c_basis: index into meta.carbon_basis, where the Scope 1 tonnage comes from
units.water_mt: Scope 1 in high water stress basins, million tonnes CO2e
units.conduct: realised environmental penalty, US$ millions per year
units.shortfall: Scope 1 times the annual shortfall against the promise, million tonnes CO2e times percentage points per year
units.cov: one coverage flag per driver, in the order of meta.drivers

carbon_price.note: 273 companies report the tonnage themselves, 48 are EPA measured, 1 is modelled. The rest have no Scope 1 number.

water_surcharge.note: 142 companies have a facility water stress share. 128 of those also have the emissions weighted share this driver needs.

conduct_multiple.note: 35 companies have no record in the violations source and cannot be priced. A priced zero is a measured zero: 255 companies paid no environmental penalty in the last five years.

credibility_charge.note: 108 companies have both a delivered trend and a promise. 1 of those has no Scope 1 tonnage to charge. 24 are cutting faster than they promised and are charged zero.

sliders.label: Carbon price
sliders.what: Charges the company for every tonne of Scope 1 it emits.
sliders.derivation: scope1_t from the master table, divided by a million so that million tonnes times US$ per tonne gives US$ millions.

reference_points.label: NGFS Phase V price in 2030, US$2010 per tonne, from data/interim/earnings_at_risk.parquet

sliders.label: Water stress surcharge
sliders.unit: US$ per tonne CO2e emitted in a high water stress basin
sliders.what: Charges a second time for the part of the fleet that sits in a stressed basin.
sliders.derivation: carbon_mt times share_co2e_high_water_stress, the share of fleet CO2e in basins Aqueduct scores as high or extremely high baseline water stress, business as usual SSP3 RCP7.0 on the 2023 fleet.
sliders.honesty: We hold an exposure share and no water price. Any value on this slider is an assumption of yours, so the default is zero.

sliders.label: Conduct multiple
sliders.unit: multiples of the realised annual environmental penalty
sliders.what: Repeats what the company already paid in environmental penalties.
sliders.derivation: penalty_usd_environment_recent5 over five years, in US$ millions per year. At the default of 1 the last five years repeat once.
sliders.honesty: A few settlements dominate. 3M alone paid 105,448 US$ per US$ million of revenue per year over the last five years, while the median company paid nothing.

sliders.label: Credibility charge
sliders.unit: US$ per tonne CO2e per percentage point of annual shortfall
sliders.what: Charges the distance between the cut a company promised each year and the cut it delivered.
sliders.derivation: carbon_mt times gap_pct_yr where the gap is positive. A positive gap is a company cutting slower than it promised. Companies ahead of their promise are charged zero rather than credited.
